description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller with endpoints for welcoming, documentation redirection, health check, and application info. It uses annotations for REST mapping, Swagger documentation, and configuration of endpoints.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: Defines REST endpoints for greeting, documentation, health check, and info, with Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message at the root URL '/'

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to Swagger UI documentation at '/swagger-ui.html'

methods.name: health
methods.description: Provides a health check status returning 'OK'
